Bus incidents: Driver saves life, passengers escape fire

Two separate bus incidents were reported across India. In Ernakulam, a bus driver paused his journey to assist in saving a life. Separately, two incidents involved buses catching fire, one in Tamil Nadu and another near Palampur, with passengers escaping unharmed in both cases due to the drivers' actions or circumstances.
